note: Registry of offer sources. A source is DISABLED until its credentials exist and its entitlement is confirmed — enabling one here does not grant access, it only tells the pipeline to try. `priority` breaks ties when two sources supply the same store+code: lower number wins. `trust` decides whether an offer from this source may be published as VERIFIED without an independent re-check.

sources.label: Manually verified
sources.note: Human-checked offers. Highest priority because a person confirmed the code at the merchant. Still passes the same quality gate as every other source — manual data does not bypass validation.

sources.label: Sovrn Product Promo Codes API
sources.note: Endpoint reachable but returns 401 for this account across every documented auth method (probed 2026-09-21: query param, secret_key param, Bearer, secret, X-Secret-Key, HTTP basic). This is an account entitlement, not a wiring fault. Do NOT re-probe on a schedule. Flip `enabled` to true only after Sovrn confirms coupon-API access.

sources.label: Sovrn / third-party JSON deal feed
sources.note: scripts/fetch-sovrn.js --mode=offers already ingests any JSON deal feed from this variable. Needs only a URL — no code change.

sources.label: CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction)
sources.note: scripts/fetch-cj.js exists and is wired for CJ's GraphQL link-search. Requires an approved CJ publisher account; approval is per-advertiser, so coverage depends on which merchants accept the application.

sources.label: Generic authorised offers endpoint
sources.note: scripts/sync-offers.js already implements fetch -> normalise -> link-guard -> merge with snapshot fallback. Any provider exposing JSON can be attached here without new code.
